failed_payments.why: The 90th percentile of days to recover is 13, within 2 days of the current 14-day window, so late payers are being cut off. G is 14 + 7 = 21 days; measure again next quarter.

order_of_work: Chose to leave: We don't use it enough

cancel_path.entry: 'Cancel plan' link on /app/settings/billing/, next to 'Change plan'
screens: Reason (optional): Costs too much for us, We don't use it enough, It's missing something we need, Moved to a different app, Closing the business, Quiet season or a break, Something else; Skip link
Answer for the reason, with 'Cancel my plan' at the same size
Done: end date, data kept 90 days, export link, restart link; confirmation email at once

answers_by_reason.answer: Growth or Business: move to the next plan down when the staff in use fits its limit (Growth up to 5 staff, Starter 1). Starter: 25% off for 3 months.
answers_by_reason.money_check: Starter discount 25% is within its 28.9% cap and keeps $6.25 a month after cost to serve. Starter and Growth have positive gross margins (57.9% and 77.6%).
answers_by_reason.why: Price-reason accepters of today's offer were mostly still paying after 90 days (9 of 13), so a discount is kept here, but not above the Starter cap.

answers_by_reason.answer: Pause for up to 2 months, with a reminder 7 days before it ends, and a 15-minute setup call for online booking.
answers_by_reason.money_check: No discount. A pause bills nothing and keeps the account's data.
answers_by_reason.why: 4 of 6 low-use customers who took 30% off had left by day 90.

answers_by_reason.answer: Ask which feature, show the closest thing that already does the job, or say plainly that it isn't planned.
answers_by_reason.why: A discount doesn't add the feature.

answers_by_reason.answer: Data export, and one optional question: what does the other tool do better?
answers_by_reason.why: Their answer feeds the product plan.

answers_by_reason.answer: Nothing to sell. Thank them and confirm.
Pause for up to 2 months, with a reminder 7 days before it ends.
answers_by_reason.money_check: No discount. A pause bills nothing.

cancel_path.dropped: The 30% offer to everyone, and the support form as a required step.

failed_payment_plan.retries: Keep Stripe Smart Retries, with the window raised from 14 to 21 days. Retries apply to 'try again later' only.
failed_payment_plan.new_card_needed: No retry on the same card; the card-update email goes on day 0.
failed_payment_plan.customer_approval_needed: A link to approve the payment goes on day 0.
failed_payment_plan.card_update_link: Use Stripe's hosted invoice link (no login). Today's email links to the logged-in billing page.
failed_payment_plan.in_app: Owner banner from day 0 until paid; a notice they must close on days 18 to 21.
failed_payment_plan.klaviyo: 'Payment Failed' already reaches Klaviyo, so the live flow 'Payment failed reminder' can carry the new emails. In the last 90 days it reached 64 people and 9 clicked (14.3%).

renewal_reminders.why: 30 days sits inside California's 15 to 45 day window; refund notes say customers didn't know the plan renewed.

plan.card_expiry_warning: not graded: the export has no card expiry dates

fairness_check.rule: Cancel screens no more than signup screens, no support contact needed
fairness_check.evidence: Signup takes 3 screens. Cancelling takes 3 screens and then a reply from support (median 2 days).

fairness_check.rule: US: simple way to stop recurring charges (ROSCA)
fairness_check.evidence: Cancelling depends on a support reply, not a mechanism the customer completes alone.

fairness_check.rule: California: online cancel for online signups; save offer shown with the cancel option (contracts from 1 July 2025)
fairness_check.evidence: The offer page shows 'Contact support to cancel', not a cancel button. Applies to customers who buy as consumers.

fairness_check.rule: California: renewal notice 15 to 45 days before a term of a year or more renews
Germany: cancellation button for contracts made online
fairness_check.evidence: No button. Applies to consumer contracts; customers here are businesses, but sole traders often sign up like consumers.
Rules there were not checked; the new path meets the same standard anyway.

cancel_path_today_in_ga4.note: 466 people opened the cancel page and 149 reached the support form. GA4 can't tell whether the rest took the offer, changed their mind or gave up. Add events cancel_started, cancel_reason, cancel_offer_accepted and cancel_completed to the new path.

messages.subject: Your Example Booking Software payment didn't go through
messages.preview: Nothing to do yet; we'll try again
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We tried to charge {{amount}} for your {{plan}} plan today and your bank declined it. This happens, and often clears up by itself. We'll try again over the next few days.

If you'd like to use another card, you can change it here, no login needed:
{{update_payment_link}}

Your bookings, reminders and client list keep working until {{grace_end_date}} while we sort it out.

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

Example Booking Software

messages.subject: Your card on file needs replacing
messages.preview: It's expired or no longer valid
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The card we have for your {{plan}} plan can't be charged any more (it's expired or no longer valid), so we couldn't take today's {{amount}}. Trying it again won't help.

Add a new card here, no login needed:
{{update_payment_link}}

Your account keeps working until {{grace_end_date}}.

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

messages.subject: Your bank wants you to approve a payment
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your bank asked you to confirm today's {{amount}} payment for your {{plan}} plan before it goes through. It takes a moment:
{{update_payment_link}}

Your account keeps working until {{grace_end_date}}.

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

Example Booking Software

messages.subject: Still unpaid: your Example Booking Software plan
messages.preview: Two minutes with a new card sorts it
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The {{amount}} for your {{plan}} plan is still unpaid. The quickest fix is a new card, here:
{{update_payment_link}}

Nothing changes for your clients until {{grace_end_date}}.

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

Example Booking Software

messages.subject: Online booking pauses in 3 days
messages.preview: Update your card to keep it running
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

On {{grace_end_date}} your online booking page and reminders will pause, because the {{amount}} payment for your {{plan}} plan is still outstanding. Your data stays safe.

Update your card here:
{{update_payment_link}}

If money is tight right now, reply and ask about pausing your plan instead.

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

Example Booking Software

messages.subject: Your Example Booking Software plan has ended
messages.preview: Your data is kept; restart any time
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We couldn't collect the {{amount}} payment, so your {{plan}} plan ended today and your booking page is offline. Your clients, services and history are kept for 90 days.

Restart with a new card here:
{{update_payment_link}}

Questions? Reply to this email or write to support@example.com.

messages.when: from day 0 until paid, account owner only
messages.body: We couldn't take your last payment. Update your card to keep online booking running. [Update card]

messages.when: days 18 to 21, account owner, must be closed
messages.body: Online booking pauses on {{grace_end_date}} because your payment is still outstanding. [Update card] [Remind me later]

Can we ask why you're cancelling? (optional)
( ) Costs too much for us
( ) We don't use it enough
( ) It's missing something we need
( ) Moved to a different app
( ) Closing the business
( ) Quiet season or a break
( ) Something else
[Continue] [Skip]  [Cancel my plan]

messages.when: cancel path screen 2, 'Costs too much for us'
messages.body:
On Growth or Business: 'You use {{staff_in_use}} staff calendars. {{lower_plan}} covers that for ${{lower_price}} a month.' [Switch to {{lower_plan}}]  [Cancel my plan]
On Starter: 'Stay on Starter at 25% less for your next 3 invoices, then $19 a month again.' [Take 25% off]  [Cancel my plan]

messages.when: cancel path screen 2, 'We don't use it enough' or 'Quiet season or a break'
messages.body:
Pause instead? No charges for up to 2 months, your clients and settings stay, and we'll remind you a week before it restarts. [Pause 1 month] [Pause 2 months]  [Cancel my plan]
(We don't use it enough only) 'Want 15 minutes with us to set up online booking?' [Book a setup call]
Your plan is cancelled. It stays active until {{period_end_date}}, and you won't be charged again. Your data is kept for 90 days. [Download your data] [Restart my plan]
